purpose: A layered geographic framework for research coverage, fieldwork planning and map navigation. Administrative boundaries and working zones are separate layers.
boundary_policy: The four local authority areas form the primary administrative coverage layer for Dublin.
Postal districts are operational work zones only; they are not legal boundaries and do not cover every part of County Dublin as a complete administrative system.
Townlands are the preferred fine-grained statutory geography for later rural and peri-urban subdivision; use official Tailte Éireann boundary datasets and preserve dataset version and attribution.
Neighbourhoods, parks, corridors and coastal zones may be added as overlapping fieldwork zones, not as substitutes for statutory boundaries.
Do not assign a discovery to a local authority solely from a postal district label where the boundary is uncertain; verify the point against an authoritative boundary layer.
Coverage status describes archive research and fieldwork, never the completeness of the underlying physical heritage.

local_authorities.name: Dublin City Council
local_authorities.coverage_notes: Initial archive research is in progress. The current catalogue contains 181 records in Dublin 1, Dublin 2 and Dublin 3 (70 in Dublin 1, 45 in Dublin 2 and 66 in Dublin 3). This is a partial research sample, not comprehensive coverage of the Dublin City Council administrative area. Verify each record against authoritative local-authority boundaries; founder fieldwork remains outstanding.

local_authorities.name: Fingal County Council
local_authorities.coverage_notes: Northern and north-western part of the Dublin local authority region; include urban, coastal and rural settlements.

local_authorities.name: South Dublin County Council
local_authorities.coverage_notes: Western and south-western part of the Dublin local authority region; include urban, suburban and rural settlements.

local_authorities.name: Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council
local_authorities.coverage_notes: Southern and south-eastern part of the Dublin local authority region, including coastal and upland locations.

working_zone_layers.name: Dublin postal districts
working_zone_layers.notes: Operational discovery and fieldwork groupings only. Not a complete administrative boundary layer.

working_zone_layers.name: Official townlands
working_zone_layers.notes: Next detailed statutory subdivision layer. Import only Dublin County records from the authoritative 2026 Tailte Éireann dataset, retaining source identifiers and boundary version.

working_zone_layers.name: Neighbourhood and settlement zones
working_zone_layers.notes: Add named neighbourhoods and settlements as fieldwork groupings with documented provenance; boundaries may be informal or overlapping.

working_zone_layers.name: Fieldwork routes and corridors
working_zone_layers.notes: Add walkable routes, streets, parks, waterfronts and heritage clusters after discovery research. A route is not an administrative area.
